summary: air carrier captain reported failing to push the thrust levers into the toga detent before takeoff.
b777 flt crew received update on volcanic activity while at cruise in over the pacific. reroute was requested from tokyo radio; and reroute was eventually received from kzoa.
a320 flight crew reported a near mid air collision with a drone during approach to landing.
a320 flight crew reported a fumes event during initial climbout resulting in a return to the departure airport.  the flight crew reported health issues and decided not to take the following flight.

an a319 ecam alerted eng 2 oil lo pr while at climb power. an emergency was declared and as the aircraft descended toward the departure airport at idle power the oil pressure returned to normal operating limits.
b737-800 captain reported the landing gear failed to retract after takeoff and the problem was apparently related to the manual gear extension door integrity.
a300 flight crew encountered anomaly with avionics equipment during approach.
an a319 crew discusses the acr's procedure of setting the lowest arr alt constraint in the mcp allowing if alt devs during dscnt.
c172 pilot reported taxiing onto the runway at the same time another aircraft was on final approach. the landing aircraft conducted a go around to avoid a collision.
b737 first officer noticed that the electric stabilizer trim was not working. the mechanic stated they fixed the problem by cleaning the electrical connectors of grease.
air carrier first officer reported a fume event after departure which dissipated shortly thereafter. the fumes returned more intense during descent and the flight diverted to a suitable airport.
air carrier pilot reported possible 5g interference while landing at ord.
a b737-700 flight crew reported severe static and musical interference on n90 tracon frequency downwind to lga runway 22.
b767-300 captain reported company notification of hazmat documentation error ten days after flight operated.

during initial climb; a b737-800 flight attendant informs captain of extremely high level wind noise at cabin door 1-left. flight crew checked and verified aircraft not pressurizing. aircraft returned to field.
acft was being marshaled into service area and struck a txwy light.

crj-900 flight crew reported a loud squealing from the main cabin door shortly after takeoff. communications was difficult between the flight crew and the forward flight attendant. the flight crew requested priority handling and  burned fuel; then performed and air turn back to land at departure airport.
pilatus pc12 plt has a track-hdg dev enrte.

b737ng flight crew reported receiving incorrect takeoff weights from dispatch. flight crew cited a dead battery on the performance computer and having to utilize dispatch for the weights as contributing factor.
flight attendant reported an emergency landing.
air carrier captain of a passenger aircraft reported a near collision with another aircraft while taxiing out for takeoff.
emb erj190 comes within 100 feet of a hang glider at 300 feet north east of ric; va; while on vectors for an ils to rwy 16.
ga pilot reported descending below minimum altitude during approach and receiving a low altitude alert from atc. pilot continued to landing.
ga pilot reported an nmac with a uav near lzu airport.
a b737-700 lost communication with den tracon on the anchr 2 arrival and suspected internal wifi interference after communication was re-established.
b757-200 flt crew encounters loss of epr indications and autothrottle failure. return to dep arpt.
tracon controller described a tcas ra event when ifr traffic inbound to the airport responded to unknown vfr traffic identified as a class b violator.
flight instructor reported they and their student neglected to check notams about uas operations at destination airport and failed to fly the correct traffic pattern as advised in the notams.
b767 cabin crew rpts encounter with moderate turb over north atlantic.

a loss of separation between two vfr aircraft; one on floats; in the vicinity of the rnt airport traffic pattern resulted in some verbal sparring on the tower frequency; promptly snuffed by the controller.
c172 student pilot reported strong surface wind on landing that resulted in a runway excursion.
zid controller experienced operational deviation when they failed to insure crossing restriction was met as aircraft transitioned into approach control airspace.
pilot reported non-standard traffic pattern procedure by other aircraft at two airports.
b767-300 flight crew reported an odor emanating from a liquid on the floor of the hazmat can. flight crew had the hazmat can removed prior to departure.
ramp personnel reported concern regarding unnecessary delays regarding hazmat (biologicals/blood) cargo from coronavirus testing. this cargo has a limited risk of spillage.
bell 206 pilot reported a tfr incursion when the tfr was extended beyond the planned time frame.
a light transport plt rpts misreading the hln rwy 27 ils commercial apch chart and receiving an egpws 'terrain' warning after commencing an early dscnt from 10000 ft.
an air carrier pilot questions whether the roc ils/loc rwy 22 requires dme; adf; and radar. all are required; but the naco chart does not indicate the radar requirement.
crj-200 captain reported that a magnetic anomaly on departure resulted in an erroneous heading indication and a clearance deviation.

a falcon 2000 captain reported an uncommanded climb from 2;000 feet to capture the ils glideslope from below; so the autopilot was disconnected and returned to the cleared altitude then continued the ils approach manually.

while holding short of the runway a c-182 pilot averted a ground collision with a conventional geared aircraft taxiing directly toward him--its high nose obscuring the pilot's forward vision--by transmitting a 'stop' command in the blind.
b737-500 autoflight functions abnormal during initial portion of flt. on apch; airspeed and flt director malfunctioned. raw data apch flown to lndg.

a320 pilot crew reported receiving an ra on final approach and executing a missed approach. crew reported ra was late; atc did not issue traffic advisory and transponder was not in ta only mode as per company policy.
a crew exited the cae cargo ramp and were confused by atc's taxi instructions using newly designated taxiways on 10-8 and 10-9 cae airport diagrams which the crew did not have.
an a320 flight crew declared an emergency due to a failed green hydraulic system and landed at their destination.
a c650 departing teb on the teb dep failed to turn as charted at 1500 ft; at least in part because of chart confusion.
air carrier flight crew reported while flying a visual approach they turned base early resulting in an unstabilized approach and late aircraft configuration.
b767-200 flt crew has clrnc change in close during civet arr to lax.

air carrier first officer reported a traffic conflict with a helicopter while on final approach in instrument conditions; then transitioning to visual conditions. atc instructed a turn and the flight performed a go-around to separate from the traffic; then returned for a landing.
a corporate jet captain reported flying for several days with no life vests on board.
sr22 pilot reported autopilot failed to level off in time and resulted in overshoot and atc low altitude alert.

captain reported numerous eicas messages and controllability issues from rotation through to landing roll with a thrust reverser malfunctioning on deployment. the aircraft was turned over to maintenance for action.
a cl60 crew misread a revised pdc for an early morning lax sid and flew an incorrect sid for the time of day.

an air carrier first officer reported rejecting takeoff when a generator tripped off line. the flight crew ran the procedure for the loss of the generator but neglected to run the newly required aborted takeoff checklist. reporter cited poor training as a factor.
an emb170 attempting to avoid a b757 wake turbulence deviated from the tracon assigned hdg dep bos rwy 9.
c172 instructor pilot reported aircraft radio failure resulted in missed ctaf communications and a near miss with a departing aircraft.
air carrier flight attendant crew reported a fume event during flight which resulted in physiological symptoms.
air carrier first officer reported the charted crossing altitudes for the amesa fix on different published arrivals to mslp do not match.
b737-800 captain reported a track deviation occurred on departure from dfw during a wake turbulence avoidance maneuver.

zsu controller voiced concern regarding the lack of communications coverage utilizing a supervisory selected back-up frequency during a primary frequency outage that resulted in a possible airspace/procedural infraction.

general aviation pilot reported disorientation and a loss of controlled flight while climbing on a missed approach in instrument conditions; resulting in an altitude and heading deviation. the pilot returned to the atc clearance and continued the flight.
an sf340 returned to the dep arpt due to l eng inboard cowling departed the acft. on gnd; found cowling missing and generator starter backed off accessory gear box by approx 6 inches.
crj-900 flight crew reported taking a climb clearance meant for another aircraft due to an apparent mistake by atc.
a cirrus sr20 operator rpts two eng case cracks at the front alternator #1 mount and prop thrust bearing. found by oil leakage.
a c208 plt leveled at 2000 ft instead of 1500 ft on the teb 5 dep.
crj 200 pilot reported hydraulic system low quantity indication in cruise. flight crew diverted and landed safely. hydraulic fluid leak was found post-flight.
pa28 flight instructor reported receiving a low altitude alert warning from atc during cruise due to uncontrolled descent in a downdraft.

a pilot landing at hpn was told to do a 360 on short final to runway 11. after the turn he was uncertain about landing clearance but landed as a precaution considering a go around over runway 16 to be unsafe.

pa34 instructor pilot reports being issued a revised clearance via airways after initially being cleared direct. no instructions are issued on how to join the airway and repeated requests for vectors go unanswered until a frequency change occurs.

a controller told an aircraft to hold short of a runway; but did not notice when the aircraft taxied onto the runway. the controller had an arrival less than two mile final and had allowed another aircraft to cross the runway from an intersection.

pilots and a controller report of confusing hold short lines near no longer active closed runway. the pilots were advised by atc that they crossed the hold short lines and should have held short of the no longer active closed runway. the pilots were told by atc that they put this on the atis right after they had crossed the hold short line. pilots stated it is not stated or shown anywhere that this would have been the correct procedure.

The pilot attempted an overshoot maneuver, following the stoppage of the port engine, at too low a speed (below the minimum control speed) resulting in an uncontrollable turn towards the Airport buildings.
l39 pilot reported encountering stall buffeting on short final and landed just sort of the runway with minor damage.

general aviation instructor pilot reported a near miss with another aircraft while maneuvering into the traffic pattern at a non-towered airport. the instructor took the controls and maneuvered to avoid the aircraft.
b737-800 flight crew reported difficulty adhering to charted altitudes on arrival into lax when wake turbulence from preceding b777 distracted them.
emb-145 flight crew reported that an apu auto-shutdown caused an extended ground event; exacerbated by lack of communication and unqualified ground crew.
a pa28 plt landed gear up following a short apch for tfc and an inop gear warning horn. mental versus paper chklist used.
ga pilot reported a nmac during final approach to onm airport.
air carrier pilot was unable to contact center during climb out to deviate for weather due to frequency congestion. a deviation was initiated before communication is established.
flight crew reported atc alerted them to a track deviation during a hold in the ase area.

an air carrier captain reported difficulty identifying the 22r hold short point while taxiing on runway 15r. then the runway 27 lahso lights were left on bright and became very distracting during the takeoff roll.
c402 pilot reported hydraulic system malfunction.

captain reported a loss of situational awareness when maneuvering at the minimum vectoring altitude while trying to locate gjt airport at night in mountainous terrain. the captain expressed concern that this approach may not be safe.

The purpose of the flight was to take a news crew to a location to cover a story. The news crew had attempted to hire another helicopter, but that operator refused due to forecast low visibility. This pilot, however, agreed to fly. Although he was certified for instrument flight in airplanes, the pilot was not qualified for instrument flight in helicopters, nor was the helicopter certified for instrument flight. The helicopter crashed & burned approximately 100' from the highway near a power line crossing. Impact occurred while the helicopter was in a shallow descent, heading away from the highway & parallel with the power line. Continued VFR flight into IMC. Overconfidence in personal ability.
citation ce-560xl flt crew has a track/hdg dev during arr to lax following a close-in rwy change.
c172 pilot flew vfr in imc until vfr on top and then; with atc assistance; landed at an alternate field that was vfr after fuel became an issue.

recreational / hobbyist uas pilot reported they were using manual flight mode during cruise flight when uas made a noncommanded right hand turn into a nearby tree. the uas suffered minor damage and was recovered.
b757 first officer reported hydraulic system malfunction during cruise. flight diverted and landed safely.

air carrier captain reported a nmac at pvu after the tower had closed and while on approach with an opposite direction non-communicating aircraft. the captain suggested the pvu tower extend operating hours to provide increased safety margins for the increasing volume of traffic.

air taxi flight crew reported while flying a visual approach to an uncontrolled airport receiving a low altitude from atc resulting in flight towards terrain. the flight crew had the airport and terrain in sight during the approach.
a pilot on approach to a residential airport runway 27 reported an individual drove an atv into the landing zone then along the runway's edge as an apparent intentional harassment.

a single engine pilot reported they entered the wrong destination into their avionics resulting in turning the wrong direction and receiving a low altitude alert from atc. the reporter was diverting from their original clearance destination to refuel the aircraft.
c172 pilots reported loosing rudder control and brakes during taxi.

hawker 800 captain reported landing at apa with braking action of fair reported by a vehicle. the reporter found the braking action to be poor and had difficulty stopping the aircraft. a captain that had landed earlier also found the braking action to be poor and reported it; but the tower chose to report only the vehicle report.

b757 first officer described the events leading up to the opening of the r1 door with the slide armed. he believes that he initially disarmed both doors and cracked the l1; but later closed the l1 and opened the r1 when the stairs were noted to be in position at that door. he may have rearmed the door just prior to opening. the slide dropped onto the stairs; but did not inflate.
a mooney 201 on visual apch to sna turned in too soon and experienced a near miss with a hawker.
emb-175 captain reported a 'dirty socks' odor during arrival. odor dissipated after turning pack 1 off.
flight instructor reported their student pilot taking evasive action to avoid a collision with another aircraft that was not on the practice area frequency.

a ce650 cas aletered fuel low pressure left and right followed by fuel boost left and right. the crew diverted to a nearby airport where the anomalies cleared. the crew refused to continue the trip with that aircraft.
a fractional company captain conducting a visual approach reported they descended too early towards the airport and received a terrain warning.

line check airman finds that one month after implementation; revised checklists are being properly conducted by only one in five flight crews. he believed that lack of proper training was the main culprit.
c-172 experienced rough running eng with associated vibration during climbout. plt returned for precautionary lndg.
a c182 pilot reported engine failure in flight and diversion to the nearest airport.
air carrier dispatcher reported a hazmat transport procedure violation due to inadequate staffing for the high departure workload.
a pa28 plt rpts narrowly missing an acft talking with atc while the rptr was coming onto the freq.
b787 flight crew reported a super tug towing a b777 opposite direction same taxiway was on a collision course with them until they used hand signals to direct the tug to avoid them.
a b777 technician rpts oil tank placards found not modified to reflect oil type change for idg's and variable spd constant freq units.
while flying the lax runway 24r ils; a be-400xp loc mfd indication was erroneous and there was no indication on the pfd. conditions were vmc so the crew used sdu for loc and glide slope information.
flt crew is issued rwy change during seavu1 arrival and successfully completes all fmc changes but forgets to engage lnav.
a widebody flight crew failed to intercept the initial leg of the pom 7 sid from ont.  believed a rapid rate of climb after takeoff to have been a contributing distraction.
a b757-200 experienced a windshield outer pane failure in cruise flt. they declared an emer and continued to dest at lower alt.
a b737 taxiing at iad in gusty winds ingested a 4 ft x 8 ft section of plastic. acft rtn to gate.
c182 pilot reported an autopilot malfunction that led to an excursion from altitude and late call to atc.
air carrier captain reported numerous sop violations in ramp operations that could lead to injury.
ramp personal reported a service truck cut through the aircraft parking envelope while an active taxi phase was in progress.
clred into pos and hold on rwy 8r in mia; b757 flt crew sees a second b757 on short final and brake to a stop with only nose and r wing across the hold short line.

an sct tracon controller reported a small beechcraft airplane departing ral via a standardized 'tower enroute control (tec)' route; ontn10 to sna failed to follow a segment consisting of a radial out of pdz to intercept v363; instead proceeding via v21-8 to sli; this event only the last of a number of similar occurrences.

air carrier captain reported an erroneous egpws indication north of bzn during descent to 11000 feet near the kicdo intersection. evasive action is taken but no high terrain is actually present. atc indicated that other aircraft have experienced similar anomalies in that area.
b737 on dscnt for sjc experienced tcas ra at fl190 with unrpted tfc.
air carrier flight crew reported descent below their planned minimum altitude during visual approach. flight crew climbed back to correct altitude and continued approach.
b737 flight crew reported a yaw damper fail message and flap malfunction while on approach. the crew broke off the approach; ran checklists; and configured the aircraft for a successful landing.
be-76 instructor pilot reported the nose gear malfunctioned and departed the aircraft on the takeoff roll.

b747-400 relief pilot experiences a main deck fire warning and goes to investigate; informing other personnel aboard of the issue. no smoke or fire is found and the reporter takes exception to the checklist requirement to begin an immediate diversion.
a ce560 crew on teb 5 sid deviated from the proc.
ground controller described a ground conflict event involving ground control and ramp control; indicating that ramp issued push back clearance to the wrong aircraft.
c182 pilot reported a runway excursion after the aircraft would not track straight on landing roll-out.
ce650 captain reports not noticing the 1;500 ft wentz crossing restriction on the ruudy 3 departure from teb. atc does notice the deviation though and instructs a descent.
pa-28 pilot reported returning to departure airport and landing on a taxiway after experiencing loss of power shortly after takeoff.
emb-145 captain reported a number 1 engine bleed leak during climbout resulting in a return to departure airport.
nct tracon controller reported assigning a vector and heading to a vfr aircraft below the mva.

b767 crew is switched from rwy 6l to rwy 7r at lax but is unable to find ils rwy 7r in their fmc database. during the scramble to get set up for rwy 7r the crew forgets to call the twr and lands without clrnc.
radar ctlr rptd md88 failed to follow the swb transition rte while flying the clare rnav sid.
an sma plt mistakenly taxied into shallow asphalt drainage ditch after lndg at las.
ce-550 pilot reported an engine failed during initial climb. flight crew returned to the departure airport and landed safely.
flight attendants reported a passenger was not complying with wearing a face mask and had to be told three times to wear it correctly.

an a320 flight crew on approach noticed some fuel-related ecam messages; but none seemed critical; and their totalizer showed 9000 lbs total fuel quantity.  after landing; maintenance discovered they actually had only 2150 lbs onboard.
a c182 failed to comply with a land and hold short clearance when the tires were locked during deceleration.
a crj-200 first officer reported a master warning for a ducting problem and diverting.
crj200 captain describes the events leading up to a fatigue call to crew scheduling.

confusion reigned at mem when an a300 flight crew crossed ltown intersection just as the airport was turning around to land to the north. when told to fly the 'north transition' the crew interpreted that to mean 'take the northerly' track from ltown. atc recognized the error and provided a clearance back to the 'southerly' track appropriate for flights landing 'to' the north.
hcf controller voiced concern when a supervisor typed in a departure altitude without coordinating with the controllers assigned position responsibilities.
pilot reported inoperative equipment at pkmj airport; such as papis and windsocks; are not being reported on notams.
a bonanza a36 pilot reported losing his vacuum pump in imc; which led to autopilot and attitude indicator failure and an altitude excursion. he diverted to a nearby airport.
a be60's r eng throttle linkage became disconnected during clb after tkof. the eng operated at reduced power during return to the dep arpt.

a captain reported maximum brake application while taxiing at dfw in order to avoid a fuel truck which appeared would not give way. the truck did stop but flight attendants were injured during the hard braking.

b737-700 captain reported during the de-icing process frozen precipitation was melting from heated cowling inlet lips and then re-freezing inside the engine inlets ahead of the compressor. reporter stated that multiple aircraft experienced this issue and that specific guidance for this situation could not be readily found. reporter suggested that the aircraft manufacturer's recommendations should be enhanced and augmented for this meteorological condition and resulting ice formation.

an md11 flt crew declares an emer when fuel quantity suddenly drops from 46k to less than 10k with dest still several hundred miles ahead. crew is ultimately able to resolve inaccurate fuel quantity indications before actually making an emer lndg at a closed and unlighted arpt.
cl65 flight crew reported taking evasive action to avoid a collision with a light aircraft on arrival into phl. reporter stated the conflict aircraft had no altitude readout on the tcas.
a ce560 flt crew missed setting 29.92 clbing through fl180. when they leveled at cruise alt; atc advised they were 400 ft low.
air carrier flight crew reported experiencing an unstabilized approach resulting in a go-around. the crew also stated they overshot their altitude during the go-around.
an emb-145 captain reported maintenance technicians had signed off a passenger door as serviceable despite advising that they were unable to successfully resolve the difficulty in opening it.

The pilot, who saw the beginning of the runway clearly, but not the rest of it, decided to make a very low run after which he re-applied power for a go-around. After starting his go-around, the aircraft struck a tractor located 50 meters from the runway edge. Heavily damaged, the plane crashed on the western edge of the diversion canal of the Rodeo gorge. Decision not to divert to Las Palmas in view of the weather conditions.
air carrier flight crew reported loss of nose wheel steering during post landing taxi.

cessna 206 pilot reported smoke in cockpit from electric air conditioner in cruise on ifr flight plan in vmc conditions. the pilot requested priority handling; diverted to an alternate and landed safely.
air carrier first officer reported the captain had to abruptly apply the brakes to avoid a collision with a truck on taxiway charlie at lax airport.
emb-175 first officer reported a flight attendant felt pressured to continue flight despite an ear blockage.

air carrier captain reported strong odors; a pack 1 fail issue and vibrations during initial descent. the flight crew decided to divert to nearest suitable airport for an expedited descent and successful landing.
air carrier captain reported momentary stick shaker and loss of aircraft control during cruise flight at high altitude.
citation cj4 pilot reported a wing over temp message during cruise and the control yoke began moving side-to-side. pilot disconnected autopilot and diverted.
a maintenance lead technician reported that airbus a320 mechanics are unable to utilize the proper equipment to install heavy landing gear parts due to lack of engineering approval.
ga pilot reported he flew into a potus tfr and was intercepted.
air carrier captain reported gps jamming that was then confirmed by salt lake center.
erj-145 flight crew reported encountering 'severe' wake turbulence climbing through 800 ft departing clt in trail of an a321.
flight instructor reported performing a go-around on short final due to a business jet landing in the opposite direction following an rnav approach.
air carrier first officer reported pgd tower's failure to provide separation on departure resulted in the flight crew needing to avoid another aircraft; and expressed concern about tower procedures.
a controller was informed of a pilot who received an erroneous altitude assignment through pdc.
lax tower controller described an asde identified conflict when a coast guard helicopter departing on a 'rescue' mission failed to follow normal instructions; turn at the beach' and turn north early.
md-80 first officer reported that when they ran the qrh for lavatory smoke alarm; one of the steps called for pulling circuit breakers that disabled communication with the cabin.

vny tower controller reported of working local control and helicopters combined became inundated with helicopter traffic and did not know who was following who to the airport. reporter sent two aircraft around due to traffic and recommended that helicopters be split from local position during busy times.
c172 pilot experiences confusion while taxiing to runway 27r at oak via c taxiway during night time conditions.  alpha taxiway is inadvertently entered which has no connection to runway 27r.
b767 flight crew reported the outer pane of the first officer's windscreen shattered in cruise. flight returned to departure airport and landed safely.
a11 controller described a conflict event involving ifr and vfr traffic complicated by local procedures and airport locations.

En route from New York City, the airliner crashed in the Caribbean sea and exploded while descending for a landing  at Maiquetia Airport. Possible sensory illusion produced by the town lights on upslope. The aircraft was named 'Clipper Malay.'
falcon 2000 captain reported that a failure to remove a pitot cover on preflight resulted in a return to the departure airport.
a g3's brakes failed on landing and the acft rolled off the rwy's end but caused no damage or injuries.
an instructor pilot reported the tower controller's instructions to their aircraft and an aircraft departing a parallel runway caused an nmac.

b737-800 flight crew reported receiving a report from a passenger that was relayed by the flight attendant of a wing access panel not flush. maintenance was called to inspect and found the panel attaching hardware loose and worn; with a wing support piece missing. the aircraft was then refused.
stearman pilot reported a ground loop during landing causing aircraft damage.
captain reported an ecam message in flight; hyd g rsvr lo lvl and hyd g eng 1 pump lopr; causing an inflight shut down and a precautionary landing.
general aviation pilot approaching downwind reported while attempting to change the landing gear indication bulb they became distracted and temporarily lost control of the aircraft.
a captain reported that the 'pilot in command' and 'second in command' persons are not recording their time per the fars.
failure to turn on pitot heat results in a possible altimetry error on the part of a pa32 private pilot.
a320 crew experiences multiple ecam warnings concerning brakes; steering; and lndg gear.
air carrier captain and flight attendant reported the captain rejected the takeoff when the forward entry door light was illuminated on takeoff.
a b737-700 was being troubleshot for a thrust reverser rpt. circuit breakers were not pulled.
air carrier with zme initiated a descent responding to a clearance that was actually issued to another; same company aircraft; with similar four digit flight number.
be36 pilot reports cowl opening in flight with emergency declared and immediate diversion to nearest arpt.
b757 crew misses crossing restriction on civet5 into lax after rwy change.
multiple distractions during flt preparation and taxi out result in incorrect tkof data entered into fgms on a319.

c208 pilot reports an airborne conflict at 10;000 feet on a555 while out of radio contact with zma. the frequency copied and readback by the reporter was not correct but not caught by the controller. since contact was not expected on the new frequency for some time; the error was not quickly discovered and 121.5 was not being monitored.

a lead aircraft maintenance technician (amt) reports about the lack of approved electrostatic grounding points for aircraft at their airport terminal gates and maintenance hardstands. maintenance procedures require aircraft to be properly grounded prior to jacking aircraft to safely perform tire and brake changes.
b757 flt crew responded to tcas ra with opposite direction tfc at cruise alt.
b737 flight crew reported that shortly after takeoff; the first officer's flight director began malfunctioning; leading to the mcp and heading bug also being inoperative.
b737 flight crew reported a bird strike on departure and returning to airport.
a kinner sportster pilot reported a low speed ground loop when a light crosswind caused loss of directional control on landing roll.
tower developmental reported an aircraft had not responded to an instruction to extend crosswind and passed under another aircraft in close proximity as a result.

air carrier captain reported receiving a low altitude alert from approach control. the captain stated that atc assigned a higher than normal speed; creating a wider arc during a turn involving a fly over fix; and the aircraft could not stay within the approach boundary.
flight instructor reported the aircraft flew close to an obstacle at night that did not have a red obstacle warning light during approach to icl airport.

a general aviation pilot reported a runway incursion at myf airport. runway signage was cited as a contributor to the event. pilot stated the sign at the hold point for runway 10r on taxiway f should read 10r/28l.
air carrier flight crew reported an inflight upset occurred when they encountered wake turbulence on arrival into clt. control was regained and a safe landing followed.

b757 first officer experiences two engine over temps in a row at 800 agl with a maintenance inspection in between; and suggests the engine may be defective and should not be repeatedly signed off by maintenance.
b737 flt crew encounters wake turbulence during arr and bumps autoplt into cws inadvertently. acft fails to make next turn on arr and is noticed by atc.

a b737-800 aileron autopilot actuator failed on final approach at flaps 1 causing the loss of system b hydraulic fluid so an emergency was declared; the airspeed adjusted and the flight continued to a normal no flap landing.

heavy cargo aircraft flight crew report being cleared to runway 28 at vidp via taxiway p and hold short. the hold bars (hs16) are crossed inadvertently as they are well back from the runway. the controllers were described as very difficult to understand.
b-787 captain reported uncommanded aircraft movement during pushback.
a319 first officer reported miscommunication with captain about the parking brake resulted in uncommanded aircraft movement and a ground loss of control.
mechanics from another carrier; being flown on a beech/ raytheon king air-100 charter with only one pilot; report cargo not properly secured and blocking emer exit.

b757 flight crew holding short of runway 28l at sfo reports a ground conflict with an a330 landing 28l.  the b757 crew is cleared to cross before the a330 arrives at the same taxiway.  an airbus on final is issued a go-around.

air carrier pilot reported atl atc informed them they failed to hold short at a taxiway intersection; but there were no chart notes indicating the hold short and atc did not issue hold short instructions.
pa44 student and instructor suffer gear collapse on lndg.

fractional jet captain reported descending below a minimum crossing altitude while on the approach; under an ifr clearance in mountainous terrain; then notified by atc that the aircraft was below the minimum vectoring altitude. the captain corrected the altitude; cancelled ifr; then continued to a visual approach and landed.

a300 flight crew experiences autoflight system malfunctions after being dispatched with the profile mode of the mcp deferred. an emergency is declared and all automation is switched off followed by a raw data ils to landing.
ztl ctlr expressed concern regarding the use of uret equip and the inability to indicate needed info on electronic strips.
an air carrier first officer reported that some captains are failing to fly the complete ndb approaches at tlpl in aircraft not equipped to fly rnav approaches.
air carrier ground personnel reported cargo office corporate acceptance process is bypassing required load planning interphase for hazmat cargo air transport.
do328 capt reports refusal to operate his acft in light freezing rain.
boi tracon controller and flight crew reported an aircraft descended below the issued altitude and below the mva.
air carrier flight crew reported that a low altitude warning activated during the approach into fsd. crew took evasive action and landed without incident.
acr dep from ewr was late in turning on newark 7 sid; listing extended work day; cockpit duties and mindset as causal factors.
out of date database in newly installed gps directs be58 flt crew to waypoint location that is no longer accurate.
a departing air carrier flight crew and an arriving air carrier captain reported the arrival initiated a go around which caused a confliction with the other reporters departing aircraft.

md88 first officer reports overshooting the assigned altitude while attempting to reduced airspeed at atc request and prevent a zoom climb by selecting vertical speed. altitude capture is negated in the attempt resulting in a 300 ft overshoot.
flight crew reported a balloon on the glideslope on final and was late to configure for landing due to being distracted by the balloon.
air carrier first officer reported experiencing a speed deviation during departure and stated lack of flying contributed to the event.
b737-900 capt expressed concerns regarding contract workers procs and training for pushback.
flight crew flying a320 questions diligence by maintenance to conduct proper troubleshooting procedure;
a b350 developed a bleed air fault after tkof imc. the solo pilot did not follow his cleared routing as he worked the system problem.
crj-700 captain reported receiving inaccurate runway data from the landing data system.
c177 pilot reported a nmac with a turboprop aircraft in the vicinity of tha airport.
b737-400 flt crew has a rwy incursion at pit.

fatigue; mel'd autothrottles and communications problems due to similar call signs contributed to the failure of an a300-600 flight crew to select landing flaps prior to receipt of an egpws configuration warning. the flight crew initiated a go-around and flew a second approach uneventfully.

c172 pilot experiences a nmac entering the traffic pattern on cross wind with an aircraft that had just departed. poor radio procedures led to a misidentification and a failure to realize that there were two aircraft in the pattern.
flight attendant reported a passenger refused to wear a face mask during flight.
sa226 made uncommanded roll when autopilot was disengaged. control was regained; and flt proceeded to the alt.

The aircraft crashed into trees in the snow, 2.5 miles short of the runway, during an instrument approach.
